title: India’s Cockroach Party Leader Carries Gen Z’s Demands. They Are Many.
summary_full: Abhijeet Dipke started the movement as a joke. But after ousting a minister over a dysfunctional college entrance exam system, India’s youth say they now want to save democracy.
